description: This file defines the SelectedCalendarRepository class, implementing data access methods for selected calendar entities, including CRUD operations, batch processing, conflict detection, and error handling, using Prisma ORM in a TypeScript project.

classes.name: SelectedCalendarRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to interact with selected calendar data in the database, including CRUD, batch operations, conflict detection, and error management.

methods.description: Finds a selected calendar by its unique ID.

methods.description: Finds a selected calendar by its channel ID.

methods.description: Updates synchronization status fields for a calendar.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates subscription-related fields for a calendar.

methods.name: findConflicting
